analyst_view.overall: Ajax (11th of 36, 6 points) host FC Thun (19th, 3 points), and the numbers make Ajax big favourites: they are unbeaten in seven, beat ADO Den Haag 3-0 on Sunday with 79% of the ball and 21 shots, and won 6-1 at Midtjylland in this competition. Thun lost 3-2 at Young Boys at the weekend and have not kept a clean sheet in 13 games; FotMob lists five Thun players out, including defender Genís Montolio (cruciate ligament, until January), none of them in the numbers' missing list, though most have been out for a while and so are already in Thun's recent form. Ajax are still without Dolberg (cruciate), Adingra and Tsygankov, all long absences the form already reflects, and they go to Feyenoord for De Klassieker on Sunday 29 November, so changes to the Ajax side are likely; Thun also play a league game three days later. No referee is named yet. I keep a small cut on goals and shots for the expected Ajax rotation and leave the rest alone.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.2 goals, 3.2 of them for Ajax, and they already add 4% for Ajax's 16 goals in their last six and Thun's leaky defence. With De Klassieker at Feyenoord three days later, Míchel is likely to rest some of the side that started against ADO (Arokodare, Gloukh, Klaassen), so I trim 4%, to about 4.0 goals. Thun's missing defenders, Montolio among them, have been out for weeks and are already in their 13 games without a clean sheet.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, 6.5 of them Ajax's, against a Thun side that has about 39% of the ball on average. Rotation changes who plays more than how Ajax play: even a changed side had 8 corners against ADO. Recent corner form is already in, so I stay at 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards, with Thun expected to collect more (2.6) chasing the ball, and both sides' recent bookings are already in. No referee has been named, and nothing points to a heated night between two sides with no rivalry. I stay at 4.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.4 shots, about 20 of them Ajax's, and already add 3% for Ajax's recent volume (21 shots against ADO). A rotated Ajax side three days before Feyenoord away is likely to slow the game once it is won, so I take off 3%, to about 29.5 shots.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target and already take about 6% off Thun's side for their weak recent accuracy. For the same Ajax rotation reason I trim 3%, to about 9.3. Thun's injured players are mostly long-term and already in their form.
